query_text: Create a ranked dot plot showing the top 10 countries by global recovery breadth, where the plotted value is `count of cities with positive numeric global_rank_change / count of cities with numeric global_rank_change` within each 3.2 national block, values are percentages, only countries with at least 4 numeric `global_rank_change` values are eligible, and countries are sorted from highest to lowest after the share is computed.
